# RoboSystems App v1.1.0

## Release Summary

This release focuses on significant infrastructure improvements and deployment optimizations that enhance application reliability and performance for the RoboSystems financial platform.

## ✨ Key Improvements

- **Enhanced Platform Reliability**: Improved application hosting infrastructure for better uptime and faster response times
- **Streamlined Development Workflow**: Updated build and deployment processes for more consistent user experience delivery
- **Improved CI/CD Pipeline**: Enhanced automated testing and deployment processes ensuring higher quality releases

## 🔧 Technical Enhancements

- **Infrastructure Migration**: Transitioned from ECS Fargate to AWS App Runner for improved scalability and reduced cold start times
- **Build Process Optimization**: Reorganized shell scripts with `.sh` extensions for better cross-platform compatibility
- **Deployment Workflow Updates**: Enhanced GitHub Actions workflows for staging and production deployments
- **Developer Tools**: Implemented new bootstrap and CI scripts for streamlined development setup
- **CloudFormation Updates**: Optimized infrastructure template for better resource management

## 📈 Performance & Reliability

- Reduced deployment complexity resulting in faster feature delivery
- Improved application startup times through App Runner optimization
- Enhanced monitoring and logging capabilities for better issue resolution
- Streamlined build processes reducing deployment time by optimizing file structure

## 🛠️ Development Experience

- Standardized shell script naming conventions for better maintainability
- Updated documentation for clearer setup instructions
- Improved CI/CD pipeline reliability for consistent deployments
- Enhanced feature branch and pull request workflows

_Note: This release contains primarily infrastructure and deployment improvements. No breaking changes affect user-facing functionality._
